messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning dedicated capacity for the new 70B quantized bring-up. Need recommendations on GPU counts and per-GPU concurrency targets for us-west1 (H100) and eu-central1 (A100). Also thinking about warmup/cache effects and autoscale headroom.

liam: tl;dr: aim for p99 tail-latency <= 250ms for interactive flows, throughput target ~1200 tok/s per cluster. rough initial numbers: H100 handles ~1.8x A100 for our kernels with q4_0.

gwen: can we start with a conservative headroom policy: reserved 20% baseline + 50% burst for autoscale? that helped on the 40B rollout.

rory: agree on headroom. also watch kv-cache warmup — first-request latency spikes. recommend prewarming hot prefixes for canary routes.

maya: numbers we saw in last bench (q4_0, batch size ~8, seq=1024):
```
H100 (flash-attn+triton kernels): median=42ms, p95=120ms, p99=220ms, tok/s/GPU=320
A100 (triton fallback): median=60ms, p95=160ms, p99=300ms, tok/s/GPU=180
```
these were single-GPU isolated. need to convert into cluster-level GPU counts for target concurrency.

liam: simple calc: target concurrent requests = 400 (steady peak). with H100 tokens/GPU ~320 -> want ~2 GPUs per 250 concurrent gen threads? hmm more precise: if each request avg 200 tokens, reqs/s per GPU = (tok/s/GPU)/(avg_tokens_per_req). so 320/200 = 1.6 reqs/s/GPU. For steady 400 concurrent and ~0.5s processing per request at median... messy. better to use concurrency headroom sim.

gwen: let's use a conservative concurrency target per GPU = 12 gen workers for H100 (q4), 8 for A100. that maps to effective concurrency capacity: H100 12*GPU_count, A100 8*GPU_count. if steady concurrent reqs=400, then GPUs needed: H100 ceil(400/12)=34, A100 ceil(400/8)=50. add reserved baseline 20% => H100=41, A100=60. add burst 50% for autoscale => plan pool sizes: H100=62, A100=90.

rory: those pool sizes feel high but safe. ops asks about cost delta — can we run mixed pools (hetero) and route low-latency traffic to H100 first with A100 fallback?

maya: yes smart routing policy will prefer H100 for critical routes, fall back to A100 when H100 saturated. need canary config: start with 10 H100 + 15 A100 for initial onboarding, ramp by 25% daily while monitoring p99 and quality metrics.

eng-ops-bot: deploy plan template created: /playbooks/dedicated/bringup-70b-quant.json. Can run dry-run traffic generator.

liam: one more: kernel mix matters. flash-attn path on H100 is ~30% faster than triton baseline for long seqs. but for q8 variants we saw stability issues. Suggest stick to q4_0 for initial canary.

sally: metrics team: we'll add eval hooks to track generation quality (SARI/ROUGE proxies) and hallucination score. if quality drops >3% vs baseline, auto-rollout pause.

maya: action items:
- liam: run sim for steady+burst with warmup cache model and produce GPU vs p99 curves (due EOD).
- gwen: draft autoscale policy (20% reserve, 50% burst) and canary ramp plan.
- rory: create prewarm job for top-1k prefixes in prod region.
- sally/metrics: add quality eval check and alert.

liam: ack. starting sims now — will attach CSVs once done.

gwen: ok will draft policy and share in this thread. :thumbsup:
